status: Exploratory execution-aligned method transfer, fixed before this run after V1-V3 and portfolio V1 inspection; not an untouched holdout or exact paper replication.
calibration: For every model, multiply volatility by sqrt(mean(validation_actual_squared / validation_prediction_squared)); freeze before test. Raw and calibrated versions both reported.
primary_forecast_metric: Equal-company mean QLIKE ratio to raw LogHAR_proxy; also pooled QLIKE, MAE and RMSE

ttm.input: 512 trailing observations of annualized daily-return rv20, including signal close
ttm.standardization: Mean and population standard deviation of each context only; inverse transform output
ttm.pretraining_overlap: Release/checkpoint postdates some evaluation observations. Exact training cutoff and complete disjointness are unverified; zero-shot here means no local fitting. Retrospective transfer benchmark, not historically available trading simulation.
